data.gender_notes: Karuna is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Karuna is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘kar’, which means ‘to do’. The name is associated with the goddess of compassion, Karunamayi, and represents the qualities of kindness, empathy, and mercy. In Hindu mythology, Karuna is believed to be a manifestation of the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity, who is also known for her compassionate nature.
data.etymology: Karuna belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Compassion, Mercy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Karuna total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
